001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents a scheduled activity with a title, start time, end time, and
007 * optional comment.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Serves as the base class for {@link HomeActivity}, {@link SchoolActivity},
011 * and {@link OtherActivity}.
012 * </p>
013 * <p>
014 * The class stores its {@link Time} references directly and enforces
015 * that the title is non-null and non-blank, start and end times are non-null,
016 * and the start time is strictly before the end time. Any violation of these
017 * invariant conditions causes an {@link IllegalArgumentException} to be thrown.
018 * For example:
019 * </p>
020 * <pre>
021 * Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 14, 30);
022 * Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 16, 30);
023 * Activity lab = new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lab", start, end, "Bring laptop");
024 * </pre>
025 */
026public class Activity implements Comparable<Activity> {
027    private String title;   // Required
028    private Time startTime; // Required
029    private Time endTime;   // Required
030    private String comment; // Optional
031
032
033
034    /*
035     * Constructors
036     */
037
038    /**
039     * Protected default constructor for serialization and subclass initialization.
040     */
041    protected Activity() {}
042   
043    /**
044     * <p>
045     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, and end time.
046     * </p>
047     * 
048     * @param title     The activity title.
049     * @param startTime The start time.
050     * @param endTime   The end time.
051     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
052     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
053     *                                  strictly before endTime.
054     */
055    public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime)
056    throws IllegalArgumentException {
057        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
058        setTitle(title);
059        setStartTime(startTime);
060        setEndTime(endTime);
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * <p>
065     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, end time, and
066     * comment.
067     * </p>
068     * 
069     * @param title     The activity title.
070     * @param startTime The start time.
071     * @param endTime   The end time.
072     * @param comment   The activity comment.
073     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
074     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
075     *                                  strictly before endTime.
076     */
077    public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
078    throws IllegalArgumentException {
079        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
080        this(title, startTime, endTime);
081        setComment(comment);
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * <p>
086     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial)
087     * string. Tokens are parsed in the following order:
088     * </p>
089     * <ol>
090     * <li>class name (ignored),</li>
091     * <li>title,</li>
092     * <li>start time,</li>
093     * <li>end time,</li>
094     * <li>comment (<code>NIL</code> is treated as no comment).</li>
095     * </ol>
096     * 
097     * @param ras RAS entry, such as
098     *            {@code <HomeActivity,Laundry,2026/10/20 09:00,2026/10/20 10:00,NIL>}.
099     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
100     */
101    public Activity(String ras)
102    throws RasException {
103        RasParser.populate(this, ras);
104    }
105
106
107
108    /*
109     * Accessors
110     */
111   
112    /**
113     * Gets the title of this activity.
114     * 
115     * @return The activity title.
116     */
117    public String getTitle() {
118        return this.title;
119    }
120    
121    /**
122     * Gets the start time of this activity.
123     * 
124     * @return The activity start time.
125     */
126    public Time getStartTime() {
127        return this.startTime;
128    }
129  
130    /**
131     * Gets the end time of this activity.
132     * 
133     * @return The activity end time.
134     */
135    public Time getEndTime() {
136        return this.endTime;
137    }
138    
139    /**
140     * Gets the comment for this activity.
141     * 
142     * @return The activity comment, or <code>null</code> if none is defined.
143     */
144    public String getComment() {
145        return this.comment;
146    }
147
148
149
150    /**
151     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
152     * Activity.
153     * 
154     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For regular Activities, this is
155     *         <code>null</code>.
156     */
157    public ActivityType getType() {
158        return null;
159    }
160
161
162
163    /*
164     * Mutators
165     */
166    
167    /**
168     * Sets the title of this activity.
169     * 
170     * @param title The new title.
171     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank.
172     */
173    public void setTitle(String title)
174    throws IllegalArgumentException {
175        if (title == null || title.isBlank())
176            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be null or blank.");
177        
178        this.title = title;
179    }
180
181    /**
182     * Sets the start time of this activity.
183     * 
184     * @param startTime The new start time.
185     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If startTime is null, or if an endTime is
186     *                                  already set and startTime is not strictly
187     *                                  before endTime.
188     */
189    public void setStartTime(Time startTime)
190    throws IllegalArgumentException {
191        if (startTime == null)
192            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time cannot be null.");
193        if (this.endTime != null
194            && startTime.compareTo(this.endTime) >= 0)
195            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time (" + startTime + ") must be before end time (" + this.endTime + ").");
196        
197        this.startTime = startTime;
198    }
199
200    /**
201     * Sets the end time of this activity.
202     * 
203     * @param endTime The new end time.
204     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If endTime is null, or if a startTime is
205     *                                  already set and endTime is not strictly after startTime.
206     */
207    public void setEndTime(Time endTime)
208    throws IllegalArgumentException {
209        if (endTime == null)
210            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time cannot be null.");
211        if (this.startTime != null
212            && this.startTime.compareTo(endTime) >= 0)
213            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time (" + endTime + ") must be after start time (" + this.startTime + ").");
214        
215        this.endTime = endTime;
216    }
217
218    /**
219     * Sets the comment for this activity.
220     * 
221     * @param comment The new comment; null or blank values clear the comment.
222     */
223    public void setComment(String comment) {
224        if (comment == null || comment.isBlank())
225            this.comment = null;
226        else
227            this.comment = comment;
228    }
229
230
231
232    /*
233     * Serialization
234     */
235
236    /**
237     * <p>
238     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
239     * </p>
240     * <p>
241     * The RAS format is a comma-separated list wrapped in angle brackets, for
242     * example:
243     * </p>
244     * 
245     * <pre>
246     * &lt;ClassName,title,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,comment&gt;
247     * </pre>
248     * <p>
249     * If no comment is set, <code>NIL</code> is used as a placeholder. For example,
250     * a <code>HomeActivity</code> titled "Morning Run" with no comment might
251     * produce:
252     * </p>
253     * 
254     * <pre>
255     * &lt;HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL&gt;
256     * </pre>
257     * 
258     * @return A single-line RAS representation; commas in field values are not
259     *         escaped.
260     */
261    public String toRAS() {
262        return RasParser.serialize(this);
263    }
264
265
266
267    /*
268     * Object Overrides
269     */
270
271    /**
272     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
273     * 
274     * @return A string representation of this activity.
275     */
276    @Override
277    public String toString() {
278        String str = String.format("%s (%s - %s)",
279            getTitle(),
280            getStartTime().toString(),
281            getEndTime().toString());
282
283        String comment = getComment();
284        if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank())
285            str = str + " (" + comment + ")";
286
287        return str;
288    }
289
290    /**
291     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another activity.
292     * 
293     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
294     * @return <code>true</code> if both activities are equal, <code>false</code>
295     *         otherwise.
296     */
297    public boolean equals(Activity other) {
298        /*
299         * compare the class first. this is necessary because HomeActivity etc. are
300         * subclasses of this one and when comparing activities of different classes
301         * (i.e. HomeActivity and SchoolActivity), the two should always be treated as
302         * unequal.
303         */
304        if (other == null || (getClass() != other.getClass()))
305            return false;
306
307        // compare title
308        if (getTitle() == null
309            ? other.getTitle() != null
310            : !getTitle().equals(other.getTitle()))
311            return false;
312
313        // compare start time
314        if (getStartTime() == null
315            ? other.getStartTime() != null
316            : !getStartTime().equals(other.getStartTime()))
317            return false;
318
319        // compare end time
320        if (getEndTime() == null
321            ? other.getEndTime() != null
322            : !getEndTime().equals(other.getEndTime()))
323            return false;
324        
325        // compare comment
326        String c1 = getComment();
327        String c2 = other.getComment();
328        if (c1 == null || c1.isBlank())
329            return c2 == null || c2.isBlank();
330        return c1.equals(c2);
331    }
332
333    /**
334     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
335     * 
336     * @param other The object to compare with.
337     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
338     *         otherwise.
339     */
340    @Override
341    public boolean equals(Object other) {
342        if (this == other)
343            return true;
344        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
345            return false;
346
347        return equals((Activity) other);
348    }
349
350    /**
351     * Compares this activity with another activity based on starting time.
352     * 
353     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
354     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this activity's
355     *         start time precedes, equals, or follows the other activity's start
356     *         time. Equal start times compare as zero even if other fields differ.
357     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
358     */
359    @Override
360    public int compareTo(Activity other)
361    throws NullPointerException {
362        if (other == null)
363            throw new NullPointerException("Cannot compare Activity to null");
364
365        /*
366         * since we are comparing based on a Time,
367         * which has its own compareTo method,
368         * we can just use that method :)
369         */
370        return getStartTime().compareTo(
371            other.getStartTime());
372    }
373}
